## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `createNode` | `createNode(cfg: tstr) -> result` | @brief Creates a liblogosdelivery node from a JSON configuration. |
| `start` | `start() -> result` | @brief Starts the delivery node. |
| `stop` | `stop() -> result` | @brief Stops the delivery node. |
| `send` | `send(contentTopic: tstr, payload: bstr) -> result` | @brief Sends a message over the active node. |
| `subscribe` | `subscribe(contentTopic: tstr) -> result` | @brief Subscribes to the supplied content topic. |
| `unsubscribe` | `unsubscribe(contentTopic: tstr) -> result` | @brief Unsubscribes from the supplied content topic. |
| `storeQuery` | `storeQuery(jsonQuery: tstr, peerAddr: tstr, timeoutMs: int) -> result` | @brief Runs a Store (historical message) query against a specific store service peer. |
| `channelCreate` | `channelCreate(channelId: tstr, contentTopic: tstr, senderId: tstr) -> result` | @brief Creates (or re-opens) a reliable channel. |
| `channelExists` | `channelExists(channelId: tstr) -> result` | @brief Checks whether a reliable channel is currently open. |
| `channelSend` | `channelSend(channelId: tstr, payload: bstr) -> result` | @brief Sends a message on a reliable channel. |
| `channelClose` | `channelClose(channelId: tstr) -> result` | @brief Closes a reliable channel: stops its SDS loops. |
| `getAvailableNodeInfoIDs` | `getAvailableNodeInfoIDs() -> result` | @brief Lists the node info items this node advertises, for use with @ref getNodeInfo. |
| `getNodeInfo` | `getNodeInfo(nodeInfoId: tstr) -> result` | @brief Returns information for the given node info item. |
| `getConnectionStatus` | `getConnectionStatus() -> result` | @brief Returns the node's current connection status. |
| `getAvailableConfigs` | `getAvailableConfigs() -> result` | @brief Information about the available configuration parameters for `createNode`. |
| `collectOpenMetricsText` | `collectOpenMetricsText() -> tstr` | @brief Returns the node's metrics as an OpenMetrics/Prometheus text document, so the `openmetrics` module can scrape this module. |
| `rlnRespond` | `rlnRespond(reqId: int, resultJson: tstr) -> result` | @brief Completes an outstanding RLN request (see the `rln*Request` events). |
| `rlnBridgeEnable` | `rlnBridgeEnable() -> result` | @brief Enables the in-process RLN bridge. |
| `rlnState` | `rlnState() -> result` | @brief Where this node's RLN stands. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `messageQueued` | `messageQueued(requestId: tstr, messageHash: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when a send is held back because the epoch's rate-limit budget is spent. |
| `messageSent` | `messageSent(requestId: tstr, messageHash: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when the network has validated a sent message. |
| `messageError` | `messageError(requestId: tstr, messageHash: tstr, error: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when the module could not send a message; `error` carries the reason. |
| `messagePropagated` | `messagePropagated(requestId: tstr, messageHash: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when a message has reached the network but is not yet validated. |
| `messageReceived` | `messageReceived(messageHash: tstr, contentTopic: tstr, payload: bstr, source: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when a message arrives on a subscribed content topic. |
| `connectionStateChanged` | `connectionStateChanged(connectionStatus: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when the node's connectivity changes. |
| `channelMessageReceived` | `channelMessageReceived(channelId: tstr, senderId: tstr, payload: bstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when a message arrives on an open reliable channel. |
| `channelMessageSent` | `channelMessageSent(channelId: tstr, requestId: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted once every segment of a @ref channelSend is confirmed. |
| `channelMessageError` | `channelMessageError(channelId: tstr, requestId: tstr, error: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when a @ref channelSend finalises with a failed segment. |
| `nodeStarted` | `nodeStarted(success: bool, message: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when @ref start finishes; `message` carries the reason when `success` is false. |
| `nodeStopped` | `nodeStopped(success: bool, message: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted when @ref stop finishes; `message` carries the reason when `success` is false. |
| `rlnStateChanged` | `rlnStateChanged(state: tstr, message: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief Emitted on every RLN bring-up transition. |
| `dispatchRlnGetMembershipStateRequestEvent` | `dispatchRlnGetMembershipStateRequestEvent(reqId: int, registryId: tstr, rlnIdentifier: tstr, timestamp: int)` | @brief RLN request events, one per ABI function (`liblogosdelivery_rln.h`). |
| `dispatchRlnGetEpochQuotaRequestEvent` | `dispatchRlnGetEpochQuotaRequestEvent(reqId: int, registryId: tstr, rlnIdentifier: tstr, epochTimestamp: int, timestamp: int)` |  |
| `dispatchRlnGenerateProofRequestEvent` | `dispatchRlnGenerateProofRequestEvent(reqId: int, registryId: tstr, rlnIdentifier: tstr, signalHex: tstr, epochTimestamp: int, timestamp: int)` |  |
| `dispatchRlnValidateProofRequestEvent` | `dispatchRlnValidateProofRequestEvent(reqId: int, registryId: tstr, rlnIdentifier: tstr, signalHex: tstr, epochTimestamp: int, proofJson: tstr, timestamp: int)` |  |
